Sacred Heart 50+ Club donates water to Locust Grove Police Department
- Special Photo
0
As featured on
GRIFFIN — During October, the Sacred Heart Parish 50+ Club of Sacred Heart Catholic Church embraced one of the corporal works of mercy, “Give drink to the thirsty.” Reflecting on Jesus’ words in Matthew 25:35, “For I was thirsty, and you gave me drink,” club members were invited to bring bottled water for a collection drive.
